description:
You are setting up tax compliance for the Urban Electronics Drupal Commerce store (http://localhost, admin / Admin1234!). The store is located in San Francisco, California and needs proper tax configuration. Complete the following tasks:

1. Update the store's timezone from UTC to 'America/Los_Angeles' (Pacific Time)
2. Add 'US' to the store's tax registration countries (indicating the store collects tax in the US)
3. Change the store's address line from '456 Market Street' to '100 Commerce Boulevard' (the store has moved)
4. Create a new customer account with username 'taxmanager', email 'tax@urbanelectronics.com', and password 'TaxAdmin2024!' to serve as the tax compliance officer
5. Enable the 'commerce_tax' module if not already enabled, and verify the store's default currency is set to USD
